title: Bootstrap TripForge app skeleton via SDD
body:
Feature-sized — route through Spec Kit (/speckit-specify -> /speckit-plan -> /speckit-tasks -> /speckit-implement). Stack is decided (ADR-0001 + docs/architecture/system-architecture.md) — the plan implements it, it does not re-litigate it.

Stand up the v1 skeleton so every later iteration has a real product to exercise:
- pnpm + turborepo monorepo: apps/web (Next.js, workspace + client-view route groups per INV-024), packages/{api,itinerary-schema stub,db,shared} (apps/mobile Expo scaffold may be a follow-up ticket)
- tRPC router mounted in apps/web with role + tenant middleware baseline (INV-023: traveler vs agent vs agency owner/admin; INV-004: agencyId scoping)
- Better Auth on Postgres (Drizzle) with the organization plugin — agency = org, roles owner/admin/member; email via mailpit locally
- docker-compose: uncomment the web service AND give it a `build:` target so `docker compose up --build` boots the built image + postgres + mailpit (INV-019, INV-027)
- `npm test` (Vitest L1) and `npm run lint` (ESLint) wired and passing; health endpoint + L3 smoke script (start real server, hit real routes incl. an auth-gated one, assert responses + DB state)
- Live verification harness (INV-027, ADR-0003): Playwright (@playwright/test) as devDep with browsers installed (`npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`), screenshot/trace-on-failure config, one e2e smoke spec (sign-in journey) under tests/e2e/; Playwright MCP (@playwright/mcp) available for agent-driven QA; create `.kitchenloop/evidence/` convention (git-ignored)
- minimal GitHub Actions CI (lint + npm test) under .github/workflows
- SEALED-GATE WIRING (do NOT edit kitchenloop.yaml — it is a sealed regulator file the loop may not merge changes to): the PR builds the smoke script, the Playwright/live harness, and the CI workflow, then files ONE OPERATOR-DESK.md row proposing the operator wire these into kitchenloop.yaml after merge — `verification.oracle.smoke_command`, `verification.live.boot_command`, `verification.live.e2e_command`, and flipping `pr_manager.require_ci` to true once CI is green. The loop cannot define its own oracle/gates; the operator applies the config. (This mirrors ideate.md Priority Zero.)

Acceptance: fresh clone -> `docker compose up --build` + one command -> app boots with zero paid services; test/lint/smoke all pass; the Playwright sign-in journey passes against the BUILT image with screenshots archived to .kitchenloop/evidence/ and a clean compose-log scan (INV-027 live verification exits pre-skeleton mode once the operator applies the desk-row config wiring); a traveler session cannot invoke a workspace procedure (INV-023/024 test); loop-state and coverage matrix can record a T1 scenario against the running app; an OPERATOR-DESK.md row proposing the kitchenloop.yaml wiring is present (the PR itself touches NO sealed path, so the loop can merge it). Quality tooling wired as devDeps with configs: knip (dead code), jscpd (duplication), dependency-cruiser (.dependency-cruiser.cjs encoding INV-017 layer boundaries).

title: Canonical itinerary schema v0 (Constitution IV) via SDD
body:
Feature-sized — route through Spec Kit.

Define the single versioned itinerary schema that flows through build -> book -> trade:
- Core entities: itinerary, day, item (stay/activity/transfer), media ref, pricing block
- Provenance fields: original author, license terms, revenue-share obligations, rebrand lineage
- JSON Schema (or zod) + TypeScript types + schema version field and migration convention

Acceptance: schema package published inside the repo; builder/booking/marketplace code may only import the itinerary type from this package. No layer may fork or privately extend it.

Depends on: seed-0001.
notes: Kitchen Loop iteration 2 execute: implemented via /speckit-implement against specs/002-canonical-itinerary-schema/tasks.md per operator D-006 (SCHEMA_VERSION 0.1.0; three item kinds stay|activity|transfer, no carRental; media source enum licensed-stock|official-embed|agent-upload|traveler-ugc). PR #4. Gates green: 51/51 vitest (29 new schema L1), tsc schema/domain/api clean, eslint clean, depcruise leaf-clean, SC-003 grep clean. Live Test N/A (library-only). UAT gate ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED (dep-less isolated worktree + gated pnpm; REG-L3-STACK class), integrity check clean.

title: Supply adapter port family + sandbox mocks (Constitution V, PRD 9.3)
body:
Feature-sized — route through Spec Kit.

Create the supplier-agnostic port family for the P0 bookable component map: hotels (bedbank net rates), activities/tickets, transfers, car rental — each with search, quote-with-markup, book, cancel — plus deterministic sandbox mock implementations for tests. Design the port contracts for the PRD 9.2/9.4 engineering realities: quote-then-book with price hold/expiry + re-quote, multi-currency, partial-failure handling in multi-supplier carts, and a merchant-of-record field per component. No supplier API shapes may leak outside an adapter. Caching split per INV-025/026: static supplier content (descriptions, amenities, media refs) is materialized into Postgres derived tables with semantic keys; live rates/quotes are NEVER cached beyond their hold/expiry. Real aggregator integrations (RateHawk/Viator/Mozio/CarTrawler class) come later behind the same ports.

Acceptance: booking flows compile against the port interfaces only; L2 contract tests run against the sandbox mocks; swapping implementations requires zero changes outside the adapter package.

Depends on: seed-0001.
notes: Kitchen Loop backlog grooming (iteration 2): confirmed in todo. Score: 8/9 (U:3 A:2 I:3) — unblocks seed-0005; dependency seed-0001 merged (PR #1). Note: this ticket's earlier promotion write left backlog.json with unescaped newlines (invalid JSON); grooming repaired the file mechanically, no content changed.

title: Regression oracle: L3 state-delta harness + PMF instrumentation events
body:
Build the 4-layer verification harness (compile -> execute -> parse -> state deltas) for TripForge:
- L3 helpers: start real app + DB, perform an action via API, assert exact DB state deltas (e.g., booking writes reservation + markup ledger rows; failed booking leaves state unchanged — conservation assertion)
- L4 helpers (INV-027, ADR-0003): Playwright journey suite run against the built compose image; per-run evidence archiving (screenshots/traces + compose log) into .kitchenloop/evidence/<iteration>/<ticket>/; a log-scan helper that fails on non-allowlisted ERROR/FATAL/Unhandled lines (allowlist starts empty, additions need PR justification)
- Money-path conservation checks per Constitution VI
- Emit the PMF metrics events from day one: marketplace take-rate revenue per active agent, resold-vs-self-built trip ratio

Acceptance: `verification.oracle.smoke_command` runs the harness in bounded time; the L4 suite + log scan run green against `docker compose up --build`; quality-bar L3 requirement and the INV-027 live-evidence requirement are enforceable in Polish.

Depends on: seed-0001.
notes: Promoted to todo by Kitchen Loop backlog grooming (iteration 2). Score: 8/9 (U:3 A:2 I:3) — unblocks seed-0005 and strengthens the verification pipeline (L3/L4 harness + PMF events); dependency seed-0001 merged (PR #1).

title: Budget allocator + quote-then-book flow (PRD 9.1/9.2/9.4) via SDD
body:
Feature-sized — route through Spec Kit. The core AI differentiator per Constitution III.

Budget allocator: split a total budget (hard cap or target) across categories (flights/transport 35-45%, accommodation 30-40%, activities 10-15%, local transport/transfers 5-10%, buffer 5-10% — tunable by trip type), pull live options per category via the supply ports, assemble to fit, re-balance when a category runs over. In P0 the flights/transport category is allocated as a reserve/manual estimate only — there is no live flight lookup (no flights supply port; deep-link flights are P2 per INV-022), so treat it as the budget anchor, not a profit line. Output: itinerary (canonical schema) with visible per-category and per-day budget breakdown.

Quote-then-book: price holds with expiry, re-quote on expiry, transparent currency conversion, multi-supplier cart with partial-failure handling (one component fails, others hold).

AI wiring (INV-013): planner drafting through LLMPort via the official Anthropic SDK, ALL calls on claude-haiku-4-5 (no Opus — operator decision). Claude tools defined in code under packages/llm/src/tools/ as typed zod definitions (betaZodTool), one file per tool, wrapping the supply ports: search_hotel_rates, search_activities, quote_transfer, quote_car_rental. The SDK tool runner drives the lookup loop; structured outputs (messages.parse + zod against the canonical itinerary schema) guarantee schema-conformant plans. Do NOT send the effort parameter (unsupported on Haiku). Deterministic LLMPort fakes in tests.

Acceptance: allocator is a pure domain function (exhaustively tested, integer minor units); plan->book conversion events emitted (PMF metric); L3 test walks describe-trip -> allocated plan -> quote -> book against sandbox mocks with state-delta assertions.

Depends on: seed-0001, seed-0002, seed-0003, seed-0004.

title: Marketplace v0: list/license/white-label + revenue-share plumbing (Constitution I/VI)
body:
Feature-sized — route through Spec Kit. The P0 Trade layer — Constitution I ("the trade layer is the moat") and Principle VI (revenue-share / client-ownership enforcement). This is the P0 marketplace pillar the other seeds do not build toward.

Build the minimal two-sided marketplace so the bootstrap sequence deterministically reaches the constitution P0 liquidity milestone ("basic marketplace where vetted agents list and other agents license/white-label trips; ratings + revenue-share plumbing", milestone: live liquidity in 1-2 destination niches):
- List a finished canonical itinerary (seed-0002 schema) as a marketplace listing with license terms
- License / white-label flow: a reseller agent licenses a listing and receives a rebranded copy whose provenance (original author, license terms, revenue-share obligations, rebrand lineage) travels with the itinerary (INV-002)
- Ratings on agents / listings
- Revenue-share plumbing recorded in the transaction path, in the same DB transaction as the license (INV-012); money math is pure integer-minor-unit in packages/domain

Lives in packages/marketplace (uses domain, itinerary-schema, ports; no supplier API shapes leak). Marketplace seller/reseller are relationships on a listing, not auth roles.

Acceptance: L3 test walks list -> license/white-label -> rate against sandbox state, with revenue-share ledger state-delta and money-path conservation assertions on the failure branch (no orphan ledger rows).

Depends on: seed-0001, seed-0002.
notes:
Promoted to todo by Kitchen Loop backlog grooming (iteration 2). Score: 7/9 (U:2 A:2 I:3) — P0 trade-layer pillar (Constitution I/VI liquidity milestone); dependencies seed-0001 (PR #1) and seed-0002 (PR #4) both merged. Note: takes the todo queue to 4 features (cap 3); accepted because the backlog holds no bug/exploration tickets and the queue was below the 5-ticket floor.
Kitchen Loop triage (iteration 2 re-run, 2026-07-07): report finding IMP-1 — the live onboarding journey proved that anyone who signs up can create an agency and instantly become an agent-owner (Better Auth organization-plugin defaults; no email verification — sign-up returns a live session immediately, mailpit never involved). Acceptable as the only P0 onboarding path today, but agenthood = marketplace supply once this seed lands (Constitution VI: 'vetted agents list'). The seed-0006 spec MUST make the who-may-list decision explicit (vetting/eligibility gate on listing creation) rather than inherit the accidental default; surface it in the speckit spec for operator review. Source: docs/internal/reports/iteration-2-report.md.

title: Land ideate-2 trust-boundary regression tests + fix false-confidence INV-020 e2e assertion
body:

Source: docs/internal/reports/iteration-2-report.md [BUG-1], [FEAT-1 coverage], Tests Added.

PROBLEM (false confidence): tests/e2e/smoke.spec.ts:22 is titled "client view carries the agent's brand, not the platform's (INV-020)" but its body only asserts the "Your trip" heading is visible on /view — it NEVER asserts platform branding ("TripForge"/"Trellis") is ABSENT. If platform branding leaked into the client view (the exact INV-020 violation), this test would still pass. A test that cannot fail for its stated reason is worse than no test (quality-bar). This is bedrock trust/provenance surface (Constitution VI, INV-020/024).

ROOT CAUSE HYPOTHESIS: smoke.spec.ts:22 is a presence-only assertion; it is missing the negative assertion for INV-020. Component: apps/web client-view route + tests/e2e suite.

UNTRACKED ARTIFACTS TO LAND (authored in ideate-2, currently untracked in the worktree — will be lost if not committed):
  - tests/e2e/trust-boundary.spec.ts — 2 tests: INV-020 NEGATIVE (no TripForge/Trellis on /view) + INV-024 surface separation. Parse-verified only (playwright test --list); NOT executed live.
  - packages/api/src/__tests__/agency-admin-rbac.test.ts — 5 tests, vitest-green; pins the agencyAdminProcedure ladder (owner/admin allowed; member/traveler FORBIDDEN with distinct reasons; anon UNAUTHORIZED). Runs in `pnpm test`.

FILE POINTERS: tests/e2e/smoke.spec.ts:22 (weak test); tests/e2e/trust-boundary.spec.ts (new); packages/api/src/__tests__/agency-admin-rbac.test.ts (new); packages/api/src/trpc.ts:49 (agencyAdminProcedure); INV-020/024/004 in docs/architecture/system-architecture.md.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:

  2. `pnpm test` green with >=22 tests incl. the 5 agency-admin RBAC caller tests; `pnpm run lint` clean.

  4. smoke.spec.ts:22 reconciled: either its assertion is STRENGTHENED in place to add the negative (never weakened) or its title is corrected to match what it actually asserts, so no falsely-titled test remains.
  5. New e2e specs live-verified against the BUILT compose image (INV-027 execute-phase Live Test & Fix), evidence archived to .kitchenloop/evidence/.

Depends on: seed-0001 (skeleton, merged).
notes: Kitchen Loop iteration 2 execute: PR #5. Landed trust-boundary.spec.ts (INV-020 negative + INV-024) + agency-admin-rbac.test.ts (5 L2 caller tests); strengthened false-confidence smoke.spec.ts:22 in place (added TripForge/Trellis absence assertions, none weakened). title: Hermetic Docker build: fresh-clone compose up --build fails — land the ideate-2 Dockerfile fix
body:
Bug-sized — direct fix; the fix is ALREADY AUTHORED AND VERIFIED in the iteration-2 worktree (kitchen/iter-2: modified apps/web/Dockerfile + new .dockerignore, uncommitted) — this ticket lands it on main via a ticketed PR (same path seed-0007 took for ideate-authored files).

Source: docs/internal/reports/iteration-2-report.md [BUG-1].

PROBLEM: `docker compose up --build` fails on every fresh checkout with `sh: next: not found` in the web build stage (same latent failure for drizzle-kit in the migrate stage). The built image was never hermetic: with an EMPTY .dockerignore, `COPY . .` silently imported the HOST machine's installed node_modules, so the INV-027 'built image' gate has been quietly depending on host state. CI never builds the image (lint/test/depcruise only), so no merge gate can see this class of break (desk row CI-IMG-BUILD proposes fixing that).

ROOT CAUSE HYPOTHESIS: the Dockerfile's migrate and build stages copy only the workspace-root node_modules from the deps stage, but pnpm places per-package bins in per-package node_modules (apps/web/node_modules/.bin/next, packages/db/node_modules/.bin/drizzle-kit). The empty .dockerignore masked it by leaking host node_modules into the build context.

FILE POINTERS: apps/web/Dockerfile (fix in kitchen/iter-2 worktree: both stages now `COPY --from=deps /app ./`); .dockerignore (new: excludes node_modules/.next/.git/.kitchenloop/.claude); .github/workflows/ci.yml (never builds the image — see desk row CI-IMG-BUILD, operator territory).

REPRODUCTION: fresh clone (no node_modules anywhere), `docker compose up --build` -> web build fails at `RUN pnpm --filter @tripforge/web build` with `sh: next: not found`.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
  1. From a clean checkout/context (no host node_modules), `docker compose up --build --wait` exits 0 with all four services healthy (postgres, mailpit, migrate exited-ok, web).
  2. `node tests/integration/smoke.mjs` passes 5/5 against that stack.
  3. .dockerignore excludes node_modules/.next/.git/.kitchenloop/.claude so host state cannot leak into the image again.
  4. Compose-log scan clean (no ERROR|FATAL|Unhandled).

EVIDENCE ALREADY IN HAND (iteration-2 ideate): clean-context build green, stack healthy, smoke 5/5, compose logs clean — see the report and .kitchenloop/evidence/iter-2/ideate-agent-onboarding/.

PRIORITY SCORE: Severity 3 (product unbootable from any fresh clone; L3/INV-027 gates silently depend on host state) + Frequency 3 (every clean environment) + Fix effort 3 (fix authored and verified; just land it) = 9/9. Escalated to critical: regress boots the live stack from clean worktrees (REG-L3-STACK Option 2), so main is broken for every clean-context consumer until this lands.

Depends on: seed-0001 (merged).
notes:
Kitchen Loop iteration 2 execute (re-run): PR #6. Clean-context compose build+boot verified (worktree has no node_modules): --wait exit 0, all services healthy; L3 smoke 5/5; vitest 51/51 + eslint clean run INSIDE the built image (host pnpm still denied — ENV-PNPM-DENY reproduced in execute); MCP QA journey screenshots + clean log scan in .kitchenloop/evidence/iter-2/seed-0010/. UAT PASS (run 1 invalidated: harness agent-worktree forked unfixed main — re-run against PR HEAD in a pinned detached worktree, 6/6 steps green, integrity clean).
Fixed in PR #6 (squash-merged as bb896ba on 2026-07-07; pr-manager pipeline: pr-auditor APPROVE after .env-exclusion review fix b6a9393, codex alignment APPROVE, codex final APPROVE, CI green, UAT PASS)

title: INV-020 live violation: /view tab title says TripForge (root metadata inherited by client-view)
body:
Bug-sized — direct fix + repro test.

Source: docs/internal/reports/iteration-2-report.md [BUG-2]. Browser-witnessed live (screenshot 04-client-view; document.title === "TripForge"), pinned red by scenarios/incubating/agent-onboarding-live/scenario.mjs (26/27 green — this is the one red, kept red on purpose; do not weaken it).

PROBLEM: INV-020 violation live in the product: the traveler's browser tab on /view says "TripForge". The client surface must carry the AGENT's brand only; the tab title and meta description are user-visible platform branding.

ROOT CAUSE HYPOTHESIS: apps/web/app/layout.tsx:3-6 exports metadata { title: "TripForge", description: platform copy } at the ROOT layout, and the (client-view) route group has no layout.tsx/metadata of its own, so /view inherits the platform <title> + description meta.

FILE POINTERS: apps/web/app/layout.tsx:3-6 (root metadata); apps/web/app/(client-view)/view/page.tsx (inheriting surface); MISSING apps/web/app/(client-view)/layout.tsx (route groups exist for exactly this, INV-024); docs/architecture/system-architecture.md INV-020/INV-024.

REPRODUCTION: `docker compose up --build --wait`, open http://localhost:3000/view, look at the tab title -> "TripForge". Scripted: `node scenarios/incubating/agent-onboarding-live/scenario.mjs` -> inv020TitleLeak assertion red.

FIX DIRECTION (from the report; not applied in ideate — product behavior is execute's job): per-route-group metadata — add (client-view)/layout.tsx carrying agent-brand/neutral metadata; platform title stays in the (workspace)/root groups only.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
  1. /view renders with NO platform branding in <title> or meta description (document.title contains neither TripForge nor Trellis).
  2. Workspace/root surfaces keep the platform title (INV-024 separation intact).
  3. The trust-boundary e2e title-negative from seed-0012 lands in the SAME PR and is witnessed red-before/green-after this fix (falsifiability).

notes:

Red-then-green witnessed: not.toHaveTitle RED pre-fix (title TripForge, screenshot+video) -> GREEN post-fix; e2e 5/5; scenario.mjs 26/27 -> 27/27; platform surfaces keep TripForge title (INV-024). vitest 51/51 + lint clean in-image. title: trust-boundary e2e cannot see title/metadata leaks — add toHaveTitle negative (same PR as seed-0011)
body:
Bug-sized — assertion ADDITION to an existing e2e spec (never a weakening). MUST land in the SAME PR as seed-0011 so the new assertion fails red on the current product and goes green with the fix.

Source: docs/internal/reports/iteration-2-report.md [BUG-3].

PROBLEM (false confidence, second layer): tests/e2e/trust-boundary.spec.ts was authored (seed-0007, PR #5, merged 05f182d) precisely to pin the INV-020 negative after the first false-confidence finding — but its assertions use getByText(/TripForge|Trellis/i), which only matches rendered BODY text, never <title>/metadata. Run live today it PASSES while BUG-2 (seed-0011) violates INV-020 in the same tab. The guard cannot see the leak it exists to catch.

ROOT CAUSE HYPOTHESIS: Playwright getByText queries rendered DOM text; document <title> and meta tags are outside it. The spec lacks a title/metadata negative assertion.

FILE POINTERS: tests/e2e/trust-boundary.spec.ts:14-21 (INV-020 negative, body-text-only); scenarios/incubating/agent-onboarding-live/scenario.mjs (raw-HTML regex already pins the stronger negative and stays as the independent witness).

REPRODUCTION: with the stack up and seed-0011 unfixed, `npx playwright test tests/e2e/trust-boundary.spec.ts` -> PASSES despite document.title === "TripForge" on /view (the exact violation class it exists to catch).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
  1. The INV-020 test in trust-boundary.spec.ts additionally asserts `await expect(page).not.toHaveTitle(/TripForge|Trellis/i)` (or an equivalent document.title/metadata negative). No existing assertion weakened or removed.

title: Add a favicon — /favicon.ico 404s on every page load (only console error in the QA journey)
body:
Improvement — small.

Source: docs/internal/reports/iteration-2-report.md [IMP-3] + Friction Points.

PROBLEM: GET /favicon.ico returns 404 on every page load — the ONLY browser console error across the entire iteration-2 live QA journey. It pollutes every future Playwright/console/log-scan pass with a known-benign error, eroding the 'console is clean' signal the Live Test & Fix gate relies on.

ROOT CAUSE HYPOTHESIS: apps/web ships no favicon asset — there is no apps/web/public/ directory and no app/icon.(ico|png|svg) metadata file, so Next.js serves 404 for the browser's implicit /favicon.ico request.

FILE POINTERS: apps/web/app/ (add app/icon.svg or app/favicon.ico per the Next.js app-router metadata-file convention); apps/web/public/ (does not exist; alternative placement).

NOTE (INV-020 interaction): the favicon is platform chrome. A platform-branded favicon inherited by /view would be a milder cousin of seed-0011's title leak — prefer a neutral glyph, or scope it per route group alongside the seed-0011 metadata fix. Do NOT use scraped/AI-fabricated imagery (PRD non-goal); a simple original glyph is fine.

REPRODUCTION: boot the stack, open any page with the devtools console open -> GET /favicon.ico 404.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
  1. GET /favicon.ico (or the app-router icon route) returns 200 on every surface.
  2. Browser console shows zero errors on landing, /workspace, and /view.
  3. Live-verified against the built compose image (INV-027).

PRIORITY SCORE: Severity 1 (cosmetic/console noise) + Frequency 3 (every page load) + Fix effort 3 (<1h) = 7/9 -> high by the triage formula (a quick win; must not displace seed-0010/seed-0011 in execute order).

Depends on: seed-0001 (merged). Related: seed-0011 (route-group metadata scoping).
notes: Kitchen Loop iteration 2 execute (re-run): PR #8. app/favicon.ico (app-router metadata file) — neutral original programmatic glyph (no platform lettering, INV-020-safe chrome; no scraped imagery). Verified live: /favicon.ico 200 image/x-icon; console 0 errors on /, /workspace, /view (was 1 favicon 404 per load); e2e 5/5; vitest 51/51 + lint clean in-image; log scan clean. UAT PASS (5/5 steps, pinned worktree d829d49, integrity clean).
